name: Phuong Huu Vu Tran
tagline: Undergraduate Researcher in Multimodal & Reliable AI
short_bio: I work on multimodal retrieval, reliable retrieval-augmented generation, evidence verification, and uncertainty-aware decision making.
bio: I am a second-year Computer Science undergraduate at Vietnamese–German University. My current research focuses on multimodal and reliable AI, including multimodal retrieval, robust retrieval-augmented generation, evidence verification, and uncertainty-aware decision making.

I have worked with PAMI Lab and RAISE Lab on multimodal retrieval, video prediction, reliable RAG, and claim verification, and have contributed to accepted work at ICDM 2026, ArgMining/ACL 2026, and the AI City Challenge Workshop at ECCV 2026.
I am interested in extending reliable multimodal methods to healthcare AI. Reach me at 10425032@student.vgu.edu.vn.
